changes: Adds browser event notifications and an expanded minimap HUD adapter.
Persists retaliation settings and fixes the disabled auto-bounty setting after reload.
Updates advertising controls and account linking, with revised activity/HUD layouts and session-routing safeguards.
Repairs Browser joins and improves cancellation of duplicate or stale join attempts.
Prepares Prime Browser support and reduces startup renderer work.
Introduces live sessions and events, favorites, reputation and moderation controls.
Adds automatic Browser asset delivery and recovery.
Expands session routing, HUD cards and Prime support with improved diagnostics and onboarding.
Repairs blank startup menus and improves advertising, settings discovery and guided setup.

items.description: Trackmatic for the Cherax Lua host.
items.compatibility: Requires the Cherax Lua API and any script-specific dependencies.
items.requirementLabel: Requires the Cherax Lua API

changes: Revises Cherax call handling and build cancellation.
Caches display calculations to reduce repeated menu work.
Packages the production interface, cleaner startup logging and error handling.
Repairs Home-tab style colors and ImGui compatibility.
Reorganizes the TrackMatic interface and tab navigation.
Improves saved-course loading, metadata and management.
Uses a flag icon and GPS route for course starts.
Adds automatically placed course-start markers.
Adds a library for saving, loading and browsing tracks.
Adds ninety point-to-point drift routes.
Adds thirty tuner settings for both Parkour and Hybrid courses.
Connects hover previews to the course planner.
Adds advanced course tuning, live 3D previews and saved tuner settings.
